comparison.objective: Extinguish a waste-bin fire with a portable extinguisher, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Acquire extinguisher, manipulate safety pin/handle, aim, and sweep versus hex-key engagement, fine collar adjustment, counterholding, locking, and cycle inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Fire suppression is title-implied; no body/specs, extinguishment duration, discharge, or safety rubric is supplied. Candidate measures safe stopping and setting retention.
comparison.reason: Emergency suppression and damper commissioning have unrelated mechanisms and tested outcomes.
